mapper.select:
select count(*) from CONSULTANT_ORG ORG
and ORG.NAME like '%' || #{name} || '%' escape '/'
and ORG.STATUS = #{status}
and exists( select 1 from CONSULTANT CON2 left join MEMBER MEM2 on (CON2.CONSULTANT_NO = MEM2.MEMBER_NO) where ORG.ORG_NO = CON2.ORG_NO
and MEM2.NAME like '%' || #{consultantName} || '%' escape '/'
and MEM2.NICKNAME like '%' || #{consultantNickname} || '%' escape '/'
)
select ORG.ORG_NO from CONSULTANT_ORG ORG left join CONSULTANT CON on (CON.ORG_NO = ORG.ORG_NO) where CON.CONSULTANT_NO = #{memberNo}

select ORG.ORG_NO ,ORG.NAME ,ORG.STATUS ,LEADER_MEM.MEMBER_NO as LEADER_NO ,LEADER_MEM.NICKNAME as LEADER_NICKNAME ,count(distinct CON.CONSULTANT_NO) as CONSULTANT_COUNT ,sum(CS_COUNT.STUDENT_COUNT) as STUDENT_COUNT from CONSULTANT_ORG ORG left join MEMBER LEADER_MEM on (LEADER_MEM.MEMBER_NO = ORG.LEADER_NO) left join CONSULTANT CON on (CON.ORG_NO = ORG.ORG_NO) left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CON.CONSULTANT_NO = CS.CONSULTANT_NO) left join ( select CONSULTANT_NO, count(*) as STUDENT_COUNT from CONSULTANT_STUDENT group by CONSULTANT_NO ) CS_COUNT on (CS_COUNT.CONSULTANT_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) where ORG.ORG_NO = #{orgNo} group by ORG.ORG_NO, ORG.NAME ,ORG.STATUS ,LEADER_MEM.MEMBER_NO ,LEADER_MEM.NICKNAME

select MEM.ID as USER_ID ,MEM.NAME ,MEM.NICKNAME ,MEM.STATUS ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME as ORG_NAME ,count(CS.STUDENT_NO) as STUDENT_COUNT from CONSULTANT CON left join MEMBER MEM on (MEM.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_ORG ORG on (ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO) left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CS.CONSULTANT_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) where CON.ORG_NO = #{orgNo} group by MEM.ID ,MEM.NAME ,MEM.NICKNAME ,MEM.STATUS ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME
select case when( count(distinct ORG_NO) = 1 and count(ORG_NO) = 2 ) then 1 else 0 end from CONSULTANT where CONSULTANT_NO in (#{no1}, #{no2})
